newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Jan-Nov deficit with Japan down 20.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Jan-Nov deficit with Japan down 20.3 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's trade deficit with Japan for the first 11 months in 1996 fell 20.3 percent to US$12.696 billion compared with the same period a year ago, the economics ministry said on Friday.
In the January-November period, Taiwan's trade with Japan totalled $37.862 billion, accounting for 19 percent of the island's total foreign trade.
Exports to Japan were $12.583 billion, up 4.4 percent from January-November 1995, while imports from Japan fell 9.7 percent to $25.279 billion.
